units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left of the full frame); time t = frame / 25

camera.evidence: phase correlation of rows 1300-2000 vs frame 0: max |shift| 0.14 px (x), 0.18 px (y) over all 40 frames (scene/scripts/cam_shifts.json)
camera.perspective: forest scene seen nearly level; the sword falls vertically in a plane facing the camera, so one px scale applies to its motion. Its apparent size is constant: pommel-to-guard 69 px both in flight (f10-f16) and at rest (f17+), so no change in depth.

objects.name: sword
objects.description: longsword with a silver blade, dark brown grip, bronze cross-guard with a round medallion, small light pommel cap; falls point-down and sticks into the top of the large mossy boulder
objects.visible_frames: 0-39 (f0-f8 only the blade is in view, hilt above the top edge; full sword in view from f10; from f17 the lower 117 px of the blade incl. the tip is inside the boulder)
objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y_mid = midpoint of pommel top and tip (assumed geometric centre / origin). The sword is rigid and only translates, so every landmark (tip_y, guard_y, pommel_top_y) gives the same per-frame displacement

size_px.guard_span_x: about 95-105 px (changes slightly while falling because the sword spins about its long axis; ~105 px, x 525-630, at rest)

objects.motion_axis: vertical, downward; x = 575.5 +-0.5 px all the time

objects.name: boulder
objects.description: large pale grey rock covered in moss at image centre, the sword sticks into its top
objects.note: edges read by eye from frame 30 with a grid, +-10 px; top surface where the sword enters at y = 1055

objects.name: small_white_rock
objects.description: small pale rock to the right of and below the boulder

objects.name: mossy_rock_foreground
objects.description: darker moss-topped rock in the foreground, lower left of the boulder
objects.note: +-10 px, edges blend into the grass

objects.name: trees
objects.description: many tall tree trunks (forest background). Notable: thick trunk left of the sword, x ~ 380-470 at y 500 and x ~ 320-390 at y 1150 (base ~y 1190); ivy-covered trunk just left of the sword behind it, x ~ 450-520 at y 900; trunk right of the boulder, x ~ 700-780 at y 1000 (base ~y 1160); trunk at far right x ~ 960-1040
objects.note: positions approximate (+-15 px), read from frame 30

objects.name: ground
objects.description: grassy forest floor, from about y 1200 down to the bottom edge; bright sun patches at lower left (x 60-220, y ~1310) and right (x 680-1120, y ~1480)

objects.name: light_effects
objects.description: fog / light shafts and small glints; the blade carries a glint (y ~ 90 in f3-f8) and a glow on the blade after it lands (f17+, around y 880-960). Light only, not objects

events.event: sword already falling at the first frame (enters from the top edge; tip at y 54 at f0, moving 11 px/frame between f0 and f1)
whole sword (pommel) first fully in view
last frame in free flight (tip at y 1049, about 6 px above the boulder top surface at y 1055)
impact / tip touches the boulder: between f16 and f17 (tip reaches y 1055 about 0.05 frame after f16)
sword at rest, stuck in the boulder (pommel 755, moved 120 px from f16, then 0 px from f17 to f39)
end of motion; remains still to the end

measurement_quality.tip_y_f0_f8: +-2-3 px (by eye from 2x zooms; f0-f3 tips sit over background sparkles)
measurement_quality.pommel_and_guard: +-2 px; pommel_top_y in the track = tip_y - 417, matches eye readings within 3 px
measurement_quality.rest_frames: pommel 755 +-1 directly measured; tip and midpoint inferred from the in-flight length
